symbols.name: IRuntimeProfilingStore
symbols.summary: Stores profiling sessions and their immutable diagnostic observations.
symbols.remarks: Implementations own atomic lifecycle coordination. Application-facing callers use readable keys, while provider and runtime code may use internal identifiers after one resolution.

symbols.name: GetOrCreateActiveSessionAsync(RuntimeProfilingSessionCreateRequest, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Atomically creates a session or returns the existing active session.

symbols.name: GetActiveSessionAsync(CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Gets the active logical session when one exists.

symbols.name: FindSessionAsync(string, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Finds a session by public readable key.

syntax.content: Task> FindSessionAsync(string sessionKey, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

symbols.name: ListSessionsAsync(CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Lists stored sessions in reverse chronological order.

symbols.name: UpdateSessionMetadataAsync(string, RuntimeProfilingSessionMetadata, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Updates editable descriptive session metadata.

syntax.content: Task> UpdateSessionMetadataAsync(string sessionKey, RuntimeProfilingSessionMetadata metadata, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

symbols.name: TryTransitionSessionAsync(Guid, IReadOnlyCollection, RuntimeProfilingSessionState, DateTimeOffset, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Transitions a session when its current state matches an expected state.

syntax.content: Task> TryTransitionSessionAsync(Guid sessionId, IReadOnlyCollection expectedStates, RuntimeProfilingSessionState nextState, DateTimeOffset transitionedUtc, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

symbols.name: FindNodeAsync(RuntimeProfilingNodeCorrelation, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Finds registered Runtime process metadata; absent remote registrations return an absent value.

symbols.name: GetOrCreateNodeAsync(RuntimeProfilingNodeCorrelation, ProfilingNode, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Gets or creates the stable profiling node for one Broadcast process registration.

syntax.content: Task> GetOrCreateNodeAsync(RuntimeProfilingNodeCorrelation correlation, ProfilingNode proposedNode, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

symbols.name: UpsertParticipationAsync(RuntimeProfilingNodeParticipation, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Adds or updates a node's session participation state and cumulative totals.

symbols.name: AddRuntimeContextAsync(RuntimeProfilingContext, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Stores immutable node runtime context once per session and node.

symbols.name: AddSnapshotAsync(RuntimeProfilingSnapshot, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Appends one immutable runtime snapshot.

syntax.content: Task> AddSnapshotAsync(RuntimeProfilingSnapshot snapshot, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

symbols.name: AddMarkerAsync(ProfilingMarker, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Atomically adds a shared marker only while the session remains active.

syntax.content: Task> AddMarkerAsync(ProfilingMarker marker, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

symbols.name: UpsertSegmentAsync(ProfilingSegment, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Adds or closes a node-owned segment.

syntax.content: Task> UpsertSegmentAsync(ProfilingSegment segment, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

symbols.name: AddMetricObservationAsync(ProfilingMetricObservation, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Appends one immutable custom metric observation.

symbols.name: GetSessionDataAsync(string, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Loads all records for one session.

syntax.content: Task> GetSessionDataAsync(string sessionKey, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

symbols.name: ImportSessionAsync(RuntimeProfilingSessionData, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Atomically inserts one complete, already-remapped terminal session graph.

parameters.description: The complete terminal session graph to insert.

returns.description: The inserted session or a typed validation or provider failure.

parameters.description: The complete terminal session graph to insert.

returns.description: The inserted session or a typed validation or provider failure.

symbols.name: DeleteSessionAsync(string, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Deletes one terminal session and all associated records.

syntax.content: Task> DeleteSessionAsync(string sessionKey, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)

symbols.name: DeleteUnpinnedSessionsAsync(CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Deletes all unpinned terminal sessions.

symbols.name: ClearAsync(CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Atomically clears the complete store only when no session is active.

symbols.name: ApplyRetentionAsync(int, TimeSpan, DateTimeOffset, CancellationToken)
symbols.summary: Applies configured age and count retention to unpinned terminal sessions.

syntax.content: Task> ApplyRetentionAsync(int maximumRetainedSessions, TimeSpan maximumSessionAge, DateTimeOffset utcNow, CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
